nativeBodyAsset.sourceReference: Leia carries and fires a blaster in A New Hope, including aboard the TantiveIV. This authored shot preserves the existing single-target blaster special without importing Force combat or an outfit from another era.
nativeBodyAsset.referenceUsage: The local white ANH outfit/bun hairstyle was inspected and supplied as costume context. Existing drawn magical shield cells are explicitly excluded from the new authored blaster choreography.
